# Task Tool Invocation

Subagent type: explorer
Task complexity: medium
Task description: Inspect local Effect branch stack

## Context
Use supplied context as authoritative. Do not repeat completed work or re-read supplied files unless writing them.
Stay within this assignment; if blocked, report the gap.

## Task
---BEGIN TASK FROM PARENT AGENT---
Read-only investigation. Do not modify anything. Return findings inline, including filepaths of any notes you would have written (none — inline only).

GOAL: Determine whether the Effect retry-interpreter work is stacked as PRs or only local.

Check in BOTH:
- /root/hevy-mcp-effect-retry-interpreter
- /root/hevy-mcp

For each repo:
1. git status --short --branch
2. git log --oneline -12
3. git remote -v
4. git branch -vv
5. Whether feat/effect-retry-interpreter tracks a remote
6. git log --oneline origin/main..HEAD if that range exists
7. Any worktrees: git worktree list

Also report SHAs for:
- 4c50934, 13454e0, d6b481b, 1073abb, e2cc2a6, fa3fc92, 1c976a1 if they exist in either repo

OUTPUT:
- Per-repo: branch, HEAD, tracking, ahead/behind, dirty
- Whether feat/effect-retry-interpreter has been pushed
- Local commit range that is not on origin
- Any related local branches (feat/effect-pure-operations, test/request-local-retry-state, test/fetch-config-merge, feat/effect-retry-interpreter)
---END TASK FROM PARENT AGENT---
